databasePolicy: PostgreSQL is mandatory for all persistent application data. Do not use MongoDB, DynamoDB, MySQL, SQLite, or other databases unless a tech-architect approval is recorded in PROJECT.md `## Stack Exceptions`. PGlite is allowed only as the hermetic test database.
versionPolicy: Use versions listed in recommendedVersion when present; otherwise use latest stable LTS or major release.
source: The core layers (runtime, language, backend, ORM, database, tests) are defined by allowedStack in plugins/golive-gate/data/build-contract.json and are only pointed to here. This radar fills concerns the stack does not cover (messaging, search, cache, storage, logging, infra) and carries the legacy `hold` ring. Adapted from https://github.com/acme-org/tech-radar/blob/main/backend.json; platform and technique rings preserved.

entries.name: Bun
entries.description: Application runtime and package manager (allowedStack). `bun install --frozen-lockfile`; bun.lock is the lockfile.

entries.name: Elysia
entries.description: HTTP framework on Bun (allowedStack). Typed routes and validation via TypeBox / Eden treaty - no second validator.

entries.name: Drizzle ORM / drizzle-kit
entries.description: ORM and migrations for PostgreSQL (allowedStack). Schema changes are major improvements and need tech-architect approval.

entries.name: PGlite (test only)
entries.description: Hermetic test database only (@electric-sql/pglite). Never for application data.

entries.name: bun test
entries.description: Unit test runner (allowedStack). Playwright is the only sanctioned second runner.

entries.name: Node.js
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Bun is the application runtime

entries.name: TypeScript
entries.description: Language for all backend services (allowedStack).

entries.name: Express
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Elysia is the HTTP framework

entries.name: Fastify
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Elysia is the HTTP framework

entries.name: NestJS
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Elysia is the HTTP framework

entries.name: Java / Spring Boot
entries.description: Not allowed for new backend work in this stack. Use Bun + Elysia.

entries.name: Go
entries.description: Not allowed for new backend work unless a tech-architect approval is recorded. Use Bun + Elysia.

entries.name: Python (Django/FastAPI)
entries.description: Not allowed for new backend work in this stack. Use Bun + Elysia.

entries.name: PostgreSQL 15
entries.description: Mandatory database for all backend services (allowedStack). All persistent data must be stored in PostgreSQL.

entries.name: PostgreSQL 1-14
entries.description: Legacy versions — do not use for new databases.

entries.name: MongoDB 6
entries.description: Do not use for new backend work. Use PostgreSQL 15 for all persistent data.

entries.name: MongoDB 1-5
entries.description: Legacy versions — do not use. Use PostgreSQL 15.

entries.name: AWS DynamoDB
entries.description: Do not use for new backend work. Use PostgreSQL 15 for persistent data.

entries.name: MySQL / MariaDB
entries.description: Do not use for new backend work. Use PostgreSQL 15.

entries.name: SQLite
entries.description: Do not use for production services. Use PostgreSQL 15.

entries.name: OpenSearch 2
entries.description: Search and analytics datastore.

entries.name: Elasticsearch 1-8
entries.description: Prefer OpenSearch 2 for new search workloads.

entries.name: Memcached
entries.description: Distributed cache for backend services. Do not use in-process caches.

entries.name: Redis (standalone)
entries.description: Prefer Memcached or managed cache unless a specific Redis feature is required.

entries.name: Kafka
entries.description: Event streaming and async integration between services.

entries.name: RabbitMQ
entries.description: Do not use for new messaging workloads — use Kafka.

entries.name: Consul
entries.description: Service discovery and application configuration.

entries.name: Vault
entries.description: Secrets and sensitive configuration.

entries.name: Docker
entries.description: Package backend services as container images.

entries.name: Kubernetes
entries.description: Container orchestration for deployed services.

entries.name: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
entries.description: Application object/file storage. Use gcs-implementations plugin — project/bucket via env, folders app-decided, GKE WIF auth (no key files).

entries.name: AWS S3
entries.description: Do not use for new company app object storage — use GCS (gcs-implementations).

entries.name: Azure Blob Storage
entries.description: Do not use for new company app object storage — use GCS (gcs-implementations).

entries.name: @google-cloud/storage
entries.description: Official JS client for GCS (works on Bun). On GKE use Workload Identity Federation - omit keyFilename (see gcs-implementations).

entries.name: Jenkins
entries.description: CI/CD automation server.

entries.name: Pino
entries.description: Structured logging for Bun/TypeScript services (gap-filler: logging).

entries.name: Jest
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use bun test

entries.name: Zod
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Elysia uses TypeBox for validation

entries.name: OpenAPI Spec (OAS)
entries.description: API contract standard for REST services.

entries.name: Prisma Migrate
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use Drizzle (drizzle-kit)

entries.name: node-postgres (pg)
entries.description: Legacy only (project Vibe Start before 2026-10-07) or tech-architect approval. Use the postgres driver through Drizzle

entries.name: Microservices Architecture
entries.description: Preferred architecture for new backend systems.

entries.name: Monolith Architecture
entries.description: Avoid for new large systems unless scope is intentionally small.

entries.name: Event-Driven Architecture
entries.description: Use Kafka for async workflows and service decoupling.

entries.name: API Gateway
entries.description: Central ingress for external and cross-squad traffic.

entries.name: Circuit Breaker
entries.description: Required for outbound calls to unstable dependencies.

entries.name: CQRS
entries.description: Separate read and write models where query complexity warrants it.

entries.name: Distributed Tracing
entries.description: Adopt for observability on multi-service flows.
